name: v2.3.0
body:
## What's Changed
* fix(runner): preserve nested workflow HITL resume responses by @chaojixinren in https://github.com/google/adk-go/pull/1129
* Consistent %w / %v usage in fmt.Errorf by @wojtas000 in https://github.com/google/adk-go/pull/1265
* fix(live): tear down the flow when LiveSession.Close is called by @hanorik in https://github.com/google/adk-go/pull/1285
* fix(ci): restrict the nightly workflow to a read-only token by @wolo-lab in https://github.com/google/adk-go/pull/1288
* Apply consistent usage of doc.go by @wojtas000 in https://github.com/google/adk-go/pull/1294
* fix(skilltoolset): accept scalar allowed-tools frontmatter by @ktsoator in https://github.com/google/adk-go/pull/1301
* fix(adkrest): add health endpoint by @vivekjm in https://github.com/google/adk-go/pull/1274
* docs: correct role alternation comment in contents_processor by @erensh27 in https://github.com/google/adk-go/pull/1302
* ci: guard the exported API against accidental breaking changes by @baptmont in https://github.com/google/adk-go/pull/1297
* fix(configurable): config loader panics on non string args by @wojtas000 in https://github.com/google/adk-go/pull/1315
* fix(session/vertexai): treat nil function args as an empty struct by @ravyg in https://github.com/google/adk-go/pull/1322
* Enable automated comment linting by @wojtas000 in https://github.com/google/adk-go/pull/1326
* Update go version to 1.26.6 by @kdroste-google in https://github.com/google/adk-go/pull/1339
* telemetry: migrate logs to OpenTelemetry 0.21 by @jadams-positron in https://github.com/google/adk-go/pull/1335
* chore(deps): bump the go-minor-patch group across 1 directory with 11 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/google/adk-go/pull/1338
* refactor: finalize streamed responses with complete metadata and unified turn completion logic by @hanorik in https://github.com/google/adk-go/pull/1355
* fix: reject tool confirmations resumed from non-agent-authored events by @prasanna8585 in https://github.com/google/adk-go/pull/1357
* fix(adka2a): mark emitted tasks with the ADK A2A extension by @baptmont in https://github.com/google/adk-go/pull/1246
* fix(adkrest): decode chunked create-session request bodies by @jesseedcp in https://github.com/google/adk-go/pull/1307
* feat(auth/gcp): add credentials-service REST client by @wolo-lab in https://github.com/google/adk-go/pull/1149
* fix(llminternal): read streaming mode from RunConfig to avoid nil deref by @rootkiller6788 in https://github.com/google/adk-go/pull/1336
* fix(llm): ignore sibling branches for current turn by @vivekjm in https://github.com/google/adk-go/pull/1367
* fix(llmagent): scope -httprecord directives so one cassette re-records alone by @chethanuk in https://github.com/google/adk-go/pull/1362
* fix(llminternal): reject tool confirmations with conflicting requests by @kdroste-google in https://github.com/google/adk-go/pull/1369
* fix: only first artifact delta from multiple tool calls is being kept by @mgmcintyre in https://github.com/google/adk-go/pull/474
* docs: Explain adka2a handler wiring by @Haihan-Jiang in https://github.com/google/adk-go/pull/893
* docs(examples/agentregistry): add discovery and capability-binding samples by @wolo-lab in https://github.com/google/adk-go/pull/1266
* docs(examples/agentregistry): add an A2A publish-and-resolve sample by @wolo-lab in https://github.com/google/adk-go/pull/1271
* chore(deps): bump the go-minor-patch group with 4 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/google/adk-go/pull/1396
* fix(internal): match the copyright skip list against slash-separated paths by @harshitwandhare in https://github.com/google/adk-go/pull/1394
* fix(llminternal): bound consecutive thought-only turns in the base flow by @jjsasha63 in https://github.com/google/adk-go/pull/1290
* fix(remoteagent): reject card sources that are neither http(s) URLs nor paths by @jjsasha63 in https://github.com/google/adk-go/pull/1328
* Fix unsafe A2A peer-supplied transferToAgent metadata by @prasanna8585 in https://github.com/google/adk-go/pull/1226
* docs(examples/workflow): add a WithUseAsOutput sample by @wolo-lab in https://github.com/google/adk-go/pull/922
* fix(session/database): maintain UpdateTime on app/user state writes by @PratikDhanave in https://github.com/google/adk-go/pull/1204
* fix(session/database): format stale-session timestamps as UnixMicro by @PratikDhanave in https://github.com/google/adk-go/pull/1237
* fix(ci): skip scheduled nightly runs on forks by @IAmSurajBobade in https://github.com/google/adk-go/pull/1366
* docs: replace the nonexistent TempStatePrefix in state delta comments by @Trainingcqy in https://github.com/google/adk-go/pull/1311
* fix(examples): remove unused code in loadartifacts by @mvsouza in https://github.com/google/adk-go/pull/635
* tool/loadartifactstool: return error instead of panic when artifact service is not configured by @GerardGao in https://github.com/google/adk-go/pull/1390
* docs: point AI coding agents at the hosted llms.txt by @wolo-lab in https://github.com/google/adk-go/pull/1402
* fix(preloadmemorytool): guard against nil parts in extractText (#1348) by @chill-czar in https://github.com/google/adk-go/pull/1349
* fix(gcsartifact): recognize wrapped storage.ErrObjectNotExist by @shoemoney in https://github.com/google/adk-go/pull/1375
* fix(agentanalytics): skip logging partial chunks in AfterModelCallback by @nuthalapativarun in https://github.com/google/adk-go/pull/1214
* Adding opt-in option for the debug endpoint in ADK REST API by @kdroste-google in https://github.com/google/adk-go/pull/1413
* test(artifact): cover version lookup after deletion by @mikemikimike in https://github.com/google/adk-go/pull/1415
* fix(loadartifactstool): support load_artifacts when combined with other tool calls by @chill-czar in https://github.com/google/adk-go/pull/1320
* fix(sequentialagent): correct New godoc placement and copy-pasted error string by @dmora in https://github.com/google/adk-go/pull/1151
* test(remoteagent): name the awaited event instead of panicking on a closed channel by @harshitwandhare in https://github.com/google/adk-go/pull/1400
* fix(session/vertexai): quote userId in AIP-160 list filter by @petrmarinec in https://github.com/google/adk-go/pull/1171
* chore(deps): bump the go-minor-patch group with 5 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/google/adk-go/pull/1425
* fix(runner): guard against nil event yielded by agent by @sundeep8967 in https://github.com/google/adk-go/pull/1417
* feat(session): carry a context-compaction record on a session event by @baptmont in https://github.com/google/adk-go/pull/1231
* feat(compaction): summarize completed invocations as the conversation grows by @baptmont in https://github.com/google/adk-go/pull/1232
* feat(compaction): compact mid-invocation once the prompt crosses a threshold by @baptmont in https://github.com/google/adk-go/pull/1234
* feat(server): make context compaction reachable from every serving surface by @baptmont in https://github.com/google/adk-go/pull/1235
* test(llmagent): drive context compaction against a recorded real model by @baptmont in https://github.com/google/adk-go/pull/1236
* fix(openaimodel): replay assistant turns with output_text content by @wojtas000 in https://github.com/google/adk-go/pull/1427
* docs(agents): add .agents/skills and a skill for authoring examples by @wolo-lab in https://github.com/google/adk-go/pull/1331
* feat(telemetry): record opt-in gen_ai content attributes on generate_content spans by @jjsasha63 in https://github.com/google/adk-go/pull/1426
* chore(version): bump the tagged version constant to 2.3.0 by @wolo-lab in https://github.com/google/adk-go/pull/1432
* fix(adkgo/deploy): derive Agent Engine builder Go version from go.mod by @PratikDhanave in https://github.com/google/adk-go/pull/1207
* fix: filter thinking parts from agenttool result by @dmora in https://github.com/google/adk-go/pull/696
* docs: fix typos in examples by @aimmetal-tech in https://github.com/google/adk-go/pull/1430
* fix(examples/openai): fix path to openaimodel package in README by @wojtas000 in https://github.com/google/adk-go/pull/1433
* fix(compaction): carry durable facts across re-summarization by @baptmont in https://github.com/google/adk-go/pull/1431
